senses.sense_definition: The mixing or blending of different races through marriage or reproduction.

examples.text: Historically, many laws were enacted to prohibit <w>miscegenation</w> between different racial groups.
The social stigma surrounding <w>miscegenation</w> has significantly decreased in many modern societies.

senses.sense_definition: A mixing or blending of distinct elements, often viewed as inappropriate or unnatural.

examples.text: The critic argued that the film was a strange <w>miscegenation</w> of horror and slapstick comedy.
The author warned against the <w>miscegenation</w> of classical traditions with modern pop culture.
